messages:
Mike (AE): Quick sync — Acme POC scoping. We need to lock down: prompts + baseline evals, success metrics, timeline, and pricing/security blockers. Can we run a 2-week POC covering 3 flows? Need decisions by EOD Fri. @Ana @Priya
Ana (SE): On it. Quick Q: do they want hosted only or are they likely to ask for Private/Dedicated? That changes the handoff and pricing.
Mike (AE): They said hosted is preferred but legal asked about dedicated/private options for KMS control. Sales already asked for SSO/SOC2 answers. Assume hosted baseline, plan for Dedicated fallback.
Priya (PM): I'll own timelines + stakeholder comms. Proposed success metrics: p95 latency < 500ms, classification top-1 accuracy >= 78% on labeled eval, summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.60, and <10% hallucination in manual spot-checks. Also uptime 99.5% for the POC window. Agree?
James (Solutions Eng): Those look reasonable. For evals we should prepare a canonical test set of 200 labeled examples across the three flows. I can spin up the eval harness. Example command: `run_eval --suite acme_baseline --samples 200 --model redwood-v1 --report acme_report.json`
Ana (SE): Draft baseline prompt inventory (first pass):
```
1) Intent classification: "Given the user message, choose the intent: [options]"
2) Entity extraction: "Extract entities and return JSON with keys: name, date, amount"
3) Short summary: "Summarize in 2 sentences focusing on outcome"
4) Re-write for tone: "Rewrite to professional customer-support tone"
5) Safety filter prompt: "If content is disallowed, respond with 'REFUSE' and flag reason"
```
Ana (SE): We'll tag each prompt with expected evaluation recipe (e.g., accuracy / ROUGE / manual-check). Owner: Redwood SE for initial curation, then customer-driven iterations.
Steve (Sales Ops): Pricing question: Is a 2-week hosted trial covered by our credit policy or do we need an estimated committed spend? If they hit Dedicated we should show ballpark delta. I can model ballpark numbers if you give expected qps and token mix.
Mike (AE): I have rough qps from the customer: avg 2 req/s, peak 10 req/s during business hours. Token mix: avg 300 tokens/request. Use that for a preliminary cost estimate.
James (Solutions Eng): Security questionnaire: they sent a 40-question doc. I'll take first pass on technical responses (KMS, data retention, isolation). Flag: they require control-plane isolation for Private. That will likely push them to Dedicated/Private.
Priya (PM): Action items: 1) SE team to publish baseline prompt set + eval suite (Ana/James) — due tomorrow EOD. 2) Sales Ops (Steve) to produce provisional pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated — due tomorrow noon. 3) PM (Priya) to update POC runbook with success metrics and sign-off process — I'll share PR. 4) Solutions Eng (James) to draft answers for security Qs and highlight blockers (KMS, audit logs).
Mike (AE): Who will curate the final prompt inventory? I'm happy to curate initial set but need a clear sign-off: Redwood SE signs off baseline, customer product signs off acceptance criteria.
Ana (SE): Agreed. I'll annotate prompts with sample inputs and expected outputs, and add 20 golden examples per flow for manual spot-checking.
James (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare the eval harness and the run script. Example: `./scripts/eval_acme.sh --prompts prompts/acme_baseline.json --gold data/acme_gold.json`
Priya (PM): Timeline check: start next Mon, 2-week window, mid-POC checkpoint end of week 1 for infra/security blockers. Final decision meeting on week 2 Friday.
Steve (Sales Ops): Noted. I'll also flag commercial asks: IP/NDA clarification and whether they need a PO.
infra-bot: deploy:perftest succeeded for acme-eval-harness (build 0.12.4) :white_check_mark:
Mike (AE): Perfect. If SEs can get the baseline prompts + eval suite in tomorrow, I'll present estimates and the runbook to the customer on Friday. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
Ana (SE): Will do — will upload prompts + eval recipe to the POC folder and ping this thread.
James (Solutions Eng): Taking the security doc now. Will share a first draft by EOD.
Priya (PM): I'll open a short checklist doc (owner, acceptance criteria, timeline, blockers) and drop link here when ready.
Mike (AE): Cool — ping me if you need extra examples from the customer. Let's try to keep the initial prompt set minimal and well-instrumented.
Steve (Sales Ops): I'll prep pricing slides and include Dedicated delta.
Priya (PM): Thanks all — closing this sync.
Mike (AE): Thanks — marking action items in Salesforce.
